# Multi-combobox: `jl-multi-combobox`

A combobox that holds several values as chips, from a list or from what the server finds.

- Class `JlMultiCombobox`, a molecule: `import { JlMultiCombobox } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/multi-combobox

A combobox that holds several values, shown as chips in the field: value and change are lists of
values. Typing narrows the list as jl-combobox's does; choosing an option adds it and keeps the list open for the next
one, and choosing it again takes it out, as do its chip's × and Backspace in the empty field. The form gets each
value under the field's name, as boxes of one name would.

Where the server finds the options, filter="none" shows them as the page gives them: listen to input, which debounce
holds back until people stop typing, and set loading while the answer comes. A value keeps its label when the options
change. For texts people write rather than choose, use jl-tag-input.

## Use

```ts
import { JlMultiCombobox } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlMultiCombobox
  clearable
  label="Cities"
  options={[{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Zürich","value":"zrh"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Genève","value":"gva"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Lausanne","value":"lsn"},{"description":"Portugal","label":"Lisbon","value":"lis"},{"description":"Denmark","label":"Copenhagen","value":"cph"},{"description":"Japan","label":"Kyoto","value":"kyo"},{"description":"Canada","label":"Montréal","value":"yul"},{"description":"New Zealand","label":"Wellington","value":"wlg"}]}
  placeholder="Add a city"
  value={["zrh"]}
/>
```

```html
<jl-multi-combobox
  clearable
  label="Cities"
  options='[{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Zürich","value":"zrh"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Genève","value":"gva"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Lausanne","value":"lsn"},{"description":"Portugal","label":"Lisbon","value":"lis"},{"description":"Denmark","label":"Copenhagen","value":"cph"},{"description":"Japan","label":"Kyoto","value":"kyo"},{"description":"Canada","label":"Montréal","value":"yul"},{"description":"New Zealand","label":"Wellington","value":"wlg"}]'
  placeholder="Add a city"
  value='["zrh"]'
></jl-multi-combobox>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `options` (attribute `options`): `ComboboxOption[]`, default `[]`. The choices: value, label, and optionally a description and disabled.
- `value` (attribute `value`): `string[]`, default `[]`. The values held, in the order they were chosen. In HTML, a JSON list, or one value.
- `placeholder` (attribute `placeholder`): `string`, default `''`. Shown while no value is held: chips take its place.
- `filter` (attribute `filter`): `'local' | 'none'`, default `'local'`. Who narrows the options to what was typed: the multi-combobox (local), or the page (none), which hears input and gives the options it found, shown as they are.
- `loading` (attribute `loading`): `boolean`, default `false`. The page is finding options: the open list says so above the options it holds, with aria-busy, and screen readers hear it. An empty answer then shows empty-text.
- `loadingText` (attribute `loading-text`): `string`, default `''`. What the list says while loading. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.
- `debounce` (attribute `debounce`): `number`, default `0`. How long people stop typing, in milliseconds, before input fires; 0 fires it at every keystroke. A choice made before cancels it.
- `allowCustom` (attribute `allow-custom`): `boolean`, default `false`. Typed text no option has as its label is added as a value of its own, on Enter or on leaving.
- `clearable` (attribute `clearable`): `boolean`, default `false`. A button empties the field, every value with it.
- `emptyText` (attribute `empty-text`): `string`, default `''`. What the list says when no option matches. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The height of a line.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data: each value is an entry of that name.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The accessible name, when no visible label names the field.
- `required` (attribute `required`): `boolean`, default `false`. The form cannot be submitted without a value.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be changed or focused; the chips stay, without their ×.
- `invalid` (attribute `invalid`): `boolean`, default `false`. Drawn in the danger colour, for an error the page found.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `string[]`: An option was added or taken out, or the field was cleared: the values held.
- `input` (`onInput` in JSX), detail `string`: The typed text changed, to find options for it: at each keystroke, or once typing pauses for debounce milliseconds.

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the text field.
- `checkValidity(): boolean`: Whether a required multi-combobox holds a value.
- `reportValidity(): boolean`: The same check; when it fails, the browser shows its message on the control.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The frame around the chips and the text field.
- `list` (part, `::part(list)`): The floating list of options.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Several cities

A choice adds a chip and keeps the list open; choosing it again or its × takes it out, Backspace in the empty field takes the last.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-multi-combobox class="demo-cities" label="Cities" placeholder="Add a city" clearable
    value='["zrh","lis"]' options='[{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Zürich","value":"zrh"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Genève","value":"gva"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Lausanne","value":"lsn"},{"description":"Portugal","label":"Lisbon","value":"lis"},{"description":"Denmark","label":"Copenhagen","value":"cph"},{"description":"Japan","label":"Kyoto","value":"kyo"},{"description":"Canada","label":"Montréal","value":"yul"},{"description":"New Zealand","label":"Wellington","value":"wlg"}]'></jl-multi-combobox>
  <p class="muted demo-cities-out" aria-live="polite">Chosen: zrh, lis</p>
</div>
```

```js
const cities = root.querySelector<JlMultiCombobox>('.demo-cities');
cities.events.register('change', (values) => {
  out.textContent = values.length === 0 ? 'No city chosen.' : `Chosen: ${values.join(', ')}`;
});
```

### Terms the server finds

A pretend server finds the terms by their name or by other names, accents or not: type "bridge" or "ecole". filter="none" shows what it found, loading shows while it answers, and debounce asks once typing pauses.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-multi-combobox class="demo-terms" label="Subjects" placeholder="Search a subject"
    filter="none" debounce="250" empty-text="No subject by that name"></jl-multi-combobox>
</div>
```

```js
const terms = root.querySelector<JlMultiCombobox>('.demo-terms');
const asked = { last: 0 };
terms.events.register('input', async (text) => {
  const ask = ++asked.last;
  terms.loading.set(true);
  const found = await api.terms({ search: text });
  if (ask !== asked.last) {
    return; // an answer for a text typed over since
  }
  terms.options.set(found.map((term) => ({ value: term.id, label: term.name })));
  terms.loading.set(false);
});
```
